summary: The focused Raw-child printing candidate remains unresolved. The old harness prints only parser-returned trees, and the supplied evidence does not show whether those trees can contain a Raw child or whether another supported setup belongs to this target.
missing_information: The complete before and after cJSON.c::parse_value bodies are needed to determine whether parsing can produce a cJSON_Raw child.

The before and after cJSON.c::cJSON_CreateRaw implementation, cJSON.h::cJSON_CreateRaw declaration, and cJSON.c::cJSON_AddItemToArray and cJSON.c::cJSON_AddItemToObject contracts are needed to determine whether constructing and inserting a Raw child is a supported setup for this target.

assessment.necessity_reason: Both versions support printing a cJSON_Raw value through array and object child printing. Whether that behavior belongs to this read target’s supported print inputs, and whether the fixed harness can reach it, depends on omitted parser and construction contracts.

before.requirement: If a cJSON_Raw child is a supported print input for this target, a valid input and supported setup must reach printing that child in an array or object.
before.reason: The harness prints only the tree returned by cJSON_ParseWithOpts. The supplied parser entry delegates value creation to the omitted parse_value body, so Raw-child reachability cannot be determined.

source_evidence.dependency_reason: Array printing delegates each child to print_value.
Object printing delegates each child to print_value.
The parser returns an item produced through parse_value, whose body is not supplied.

after.requirement: If a cJSON_Raw child is a supported print input for this target, a valid input and supported setup must reach printing that child in an array or object.
after.reason: Raw printing and array and object child delegation remain supported, but the omitted parser and construction contracts still prevent a determination of scope or reachability.
